PLAN "Post-MI General Fitness Programme (12 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve general fitness and strength safely post-MI"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          chest_press_machine 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row_machine 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          bodyweight_box_squat 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          recumbent_bike 5m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          recumbent_bike 10m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_shoulder_press_seated 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
